children: on Wednesday it priced an underwritten public offering of $20.08M of additional 8% unsecured notes due 2031, with the underwriters granted an option to purchase up to an additional $3M of notes.
The notes will mature on Aug. 31, 2031, with interest payable quarterly at an 8% annual rate starting Nov. 30, 2026.
Upon issuance, the total outstanding principal of the 8% notes due in 2031 will be $117.83M, assuming no exercise of the overallotment option.
The offering is expected to close on Sept. 24.
The company plans to use net proceeds to repay part of the outstanding debt under its special purpose vehicle financing credit facility with Valley National Bank.
The notes may be redeemed at the company's option on or after Aug. 26, 2028.
Egan-Jones assigned the company a private BBB investment-grade rating.
Lucid Capital Markets, LLC, and Oppenheimer & Co. are serving as joint book-running managers for this offering.
